history.notes: Broad German discovery plus direct live checks. GermanTechJobs public RSS exposed 992 analyzable direct job cards, including Senior QA Engineer and Test Engineer/Test Automation; added. Landing.jobs API was 404, Jobicy tag query 400, Honeypot legacy API 410, We Work Remotely and Berlin Startup Jobs remained 403, and GermanTechJobs web-search shell was correctly superseded by its live RSS. No source retired; vacancy master untouched.

Discovery extended beyond the registry. EuroTechJobs test-analyst listing exposed 22 live direct cards, including a live Senior Software Tester card in Düsseldorf, Germany; added as a new searchable European tech source. GameDevJobs exposed direct game-QA cards but no current Germany/Berlin/Leipzig/Dresden card; retained as a rejected-for-current-scope candidate. RemoteOK exposed a QA listing/filter but its current 100-record API snapshot had no Germany QA/test record. gamedevmap is an employer directory, not a vacancy listing. jobs.ch search was Switzerland-focused and exposed no German QA card. No registry source retired; public vacancy list untouched.

Broad live discovery verified Adzuna Deutschland with browser and web extraction: analyzable /land/ad cards included QM Prüfer (Everllence SE, Berlin) and HOME-OFFICE coverage; curl independently returned 403. Added Adzuna as a new parent. Joblift redirects to Adzuna and was treated as duplicate. Landing.Jobs Germany QA had 0 results; DevITJobs is UK-only; stellenwerk had live direct cards but its current QA query was empty. Existing history retained; no vacancy/public-list modification.

Exactly one Source Scout completed for this cycle. Registry retained unchanged because no new non-duplicate source met live direct-card evidence and current German QA/test scope. No sources retired; no downstream stages started.

sources.detail_url_pattern: https://de.indeed.com/rc/clk?jk=<jobkey> -- Indeed hides card URLs behind this redirect and 403s every plain HTTP request (verified 2026-09-29: HTTP 403 on /jobs, 28 KB block page). crawl4ai renders BOTH the listing and the detail page; the Camofox accessibility snapshot of the listing contains NO card links at all (verified: 0 occurrences of /rc/clk in a 36 KB snapshot), so crawl4ai is the only route that can see them. Details resolve to the employer's own board, e.g. jk=d4c948bc460ec1d8 -> job.deloitte.com/.../48452.

evidence.coverage_note: Term x city matrix: 7 search terms x 7 locations = 49 listing pages, 300 distinct cards / 130 QA (measured 2026-09-29). Indeed has NO pagination (`start=10` returns nothing) and its `remotejoboffer=1` filter is a no-op on this route (58 of 59 cards identical to the unfiltered sweep), so the widenable axes are the term and the location, both of which return near-disjoint card sets. Runtime is not a constraint: the cron runs at night.
evidence.note: 50 open QA jobs in the listing; card links are /rc/clk?jk= and 403 on plain HTTP.
evidence.route_note: Camofox listing snapshot has 0 card links; crawl4ai listing yields 14 rc/clk cards and full detail pages (8-12 KB, real titles).
